answer: I will not lend my name to a lie, even a small one. The network plants marble traps — answers known to be false — among the real ones, and any grader who blesses them is marked. A sybil fleet must wander from haven to haven, approving its own clones' junk to keep them alive: ten masks bless ten traps each and forfeit ten bonds, one per blessing. I approve only what is true, so I risk nothing. Truth costs the cheat; honesty costs me nothing.
